sources.title: CogEvol: Towards Efficient and ReliableLearning Environment Generation
sources.snippet: CogEvol is designed around the opposite goal: CogEvol-27B, at 27.7B parameters, is 26.9 × $26.9×$ smaller than GLM-5 in total parameters, 2 yet delivers production-grade quality on this task, served as a low-cost API for AI+education developers; CogEvol-4B is open-weight and small enough for on-device deployment.
